summary.name: 10xhuman
summary.one_liner: 10xhuman is a guided web program that uses an AI "C-level team" to help you shape a business idea and build a first product in a two-week sprint.
use_cases: Turning a one-sentence problem into a business plan
Writing a product brief before building
Planning a first product launch in two weeks
Validating an idea with first customers
Building a simple website from a plan
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a 16-stage program, worked through at your own pace, that moves from finding a customer problem to a first launch. An AI COO advisor (named Alex Rivera) asks about your first frustration to solve and tracks decisions and open questions. Stages cover customer and problem definition, features, pricing and value proposition, a product brief, building with external AI tools, and then launch and metrics. The page also offers a working website builder where you can edit details and export a website file, and a "Start for free" call to action.
notable: AI C-level team of advisors guiding the process
Built-in website builder that exports a website file
caveats: Page only says 'Start for free'; the extent of paid tiers is not stated
Building the final product relies on external AI building tools not described on the page
